definitions.explanation: The largest figure in a set of measurements or the highest value a function or quantity takes. A technical term used in mathematics, statistics, and engineering.

examples.japanese: ⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最大値|さいだいち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{取|と}る→読み取る：04602_yomitoru⟧。
examples.english: Read off the maximum value from the graph.

examples.japanese: ⟦{測定|そくてい}→測定：04398_sokutei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{最大値|さいだいち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五十|ごじゅう}→五十：00930_gojuu⟧だった。
examples.english: The maximum value among the measurements was fifty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最大値|さいだいち}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{最小値|さいしょうち}→最小値：30166_saishouchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ほど、⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}し→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧やすい。
examples.english: The larger the gap between the maximum and minimum temperature values, the easier it is to fall ill.

notes:
⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧ (largest) + {値|ち} (value). The {値|ち} reading appears only in technical compounds; the same kanji is read ⟦{値|あたい}→値：21704_atai⟧ on its own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最大値|さいだいち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to find the maximum value
- {最大値|さいだいち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take its maximum value
- {最大値|さいだいち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to exceed the maximum value

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最小値|さいしょうち}→最小値：30166_saishouchi⟧: minimum value — the direct opposite
- ⟦{平均値|へいきんち}→平均値：30167_heikinchi⟧: average value — the same {値|ち} pattern applied to the mean
